current_metrics.methodology_label:
Same-tenor cross-country linker real-yield differential between
two linker curves' real-yield levels at the same tenor (e.g.
USD_TIPS 10Y real yield minus GBP_LINKER 10Y real yield,
USD_TIPS 5Y real yield minus EUR_FR_LINKER 5Y real yield,
GBP_LINKER 10Y real yield minus CAD_RRB 10Y real yield).
Computed per-trade-date via the SPREAD formula:

  spread_pct = first_curve_real_yield_pct - second_curve_real_yield_pct

where ``first_curve_real_yield_pct`` and
``second_curve_real_yield_pct`` are the linker real-yield levels
at ``tenor`` for first_curve_family and second_curve_family
respectively (each computed by ``get_real_yield_level`` filtered
by ``instrument_type='inflation_linker'`` AND
``curve_family=?`` AND ``tenor=?`` AND ``field_name=?`` — the
no-proxy guard inherited transitively from the level
primitive's compute path).  The two real-yield series are
aligned per-trade-date via a strict pandas inner-join on
calendar trade_date AFTER each is computed independently; the
spread is computed only on dates where BOTH curves exist (no
synthetic spread points are produced).

Sign convention is FIXED at first_curve_family minus
second_curve_family — the tool NEVER silently flips the sign.
If the caller wants second minus first, they must swap the
input curves.

Cross-country construction by design: first_curve_family and
second_curve_family MUST be different linker curve families
(e.g. USD_TIPS vs GBP_LINKER, USD_TIPS vs EUR_FR_LINKER,
GBP_LINKER vs CAD_RRB).  Identical curves on both legs are
rejected at the schema layer — for same-country curve-shape
work (e.g. USD_TIPS 5s10s real-yield), use
``calculate_real_yield_curve_spread_tool``.  Compute
additionally re-asserts that BOTH curve_families resolve under
``instrument_type='inflation_linker'`` AND a single
``(country, currency)`` tuple — a non-linker curve_family on
either side (e.g. a nominal sovereign 'UST' or 'DE_BUND')
yields a controlled error envelope BEFORE any market-data
fetch fires.

The output is a CROSS-COUNTRY REAL-RATE DIFFERENTIAL — i.e. a
measure of how much higher / lower one country's linker real
yield is than another's at the same tenor.  Distinct from a
cross-country breakeven differential (which differences two
inflation-compensation legs) and from a sovereign nominal
cross-market spread (which differences two nominal yields).
Real yields are quoted in PERCENT and the spread is reported in
PERCENT — same units as the underlying.  Daily / weekly /
monthly *changes* of the spread are reported in BPS, matching
the desk convention for change reporting on any rate level.

INDEX-FAMILY MISMATCH (load-bearing): different countries'
linkers reference DIFFERENT inflation indices — USD TIPS
reference CPI-U non-seasonally adjusted, EUR-area linkers
reference HICP ex-tobacco, UK linkers reference RPI (legacy
issues) or CPIH (newer issues), Canadian RRBs reference Canada
CPI.  These are NOT identical inflation references.  The
real-yield levels this tool differences are quoted against
their own country's index family — a US 10Y real yield minus a
UK 10Y real yield is therefore a CPI-U-vs-RPI real-rate
differential, NOT a "pure cross-country real-rate
differential" in any strong sense.  This tool does NOT attempt
to harmonise indices (no harmonisation is performed) because
doing so would require seasonally-adjusted / index-conversion
metadata the repo does not yet ingest.

MARKET-STRUCTURE MISMATCH (load-bearing): linker markets
differ materially across countries in benchmark availability
at the same tenor pillar, issuance size, liquidity premium,
and deflation-floor treatment.  USD TIPS, GBP linkers,
EUR-area linkers and Canadian RRBs are NOT fungible at the
same tenor.  The cross-country real-yield differential
therefore reflects both real-rate divergence AND relative
linker-market liquidity / structure differences — interpret
accordingly.

time_series_spread.description: Cross-country linker real-yield spread (USD_TIPS - GBP_LINKER) at 10Y (first_curve_real_yield_pct - second_curve_real_yield_pct) over the displayed window.  Cross-country real-rate differential for (US, USD) vs (UK, GBP) linkers; distinct from a cross-country breakeven differential (inflation compensation) and from a sovereign nominal cross-market spread.  Quoted in PERCENT (same units as the underlying real yields).  Subject to index-family mismatch caveat (CPI-U vs HICP vs RPI vs CAN_CPI) AND market-structure mismatch caveat (cross-country linker-liquidity / issuance-size differences) — see the tool's methodology disclosure.

time_series_zscore.description: Rolling z-score of the cross-country linker real-yield spread (USD_TIPS - GBP_LINKER) at 10Y vs its own trailing window.
